The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. A distinct blue eye-ring is visible. Notably, there is a second, smaller, darker fish head partially visible behind the main subject's head/pectoral area, appearing fused or overlapping.
